TZA.note: Only a way for people or institutions to check cards, once NIDA enables it; no online authentication service stated.
Nothing on a civil register to ID link.
No enrolment count or share is given.
Nothing on an ID number at birth.
NIDA producing cards is stated, but not who operates or maintains the system or platform.
Nothing on registers keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: Mwananchi reports NIDA, per its production director and director general, registers people at district offices and issues national IDs, whose number is each person's identity, with a new-generation card announced for new registrants.
